{{Top|leg}}
A '''region''' was a level of territorial organization within the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Territory Administration]], directly below the level of [[territory]]. Each region was controlled by a [[Regional Director]], and there were typically ten regions within a territory, although some had as few as three, and some as many as forty.
